facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite contractual agreement on 4 February 2026 in Djibouti to implement Horizon Fiber, a cross-border fibre corridor from Djibouti's landing stations through Ethiopia into Sudan.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
